answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each wallet maps to a verified operator account; any wallet caught in a sybil cluster triggers a zephyr-sized penalty drawn from that operator's shared escrow, scaling with cluster size. Operators can run one identity per lagoon of registered hardware, and each extra alias requires posting saffron-tier collateral locked for 90 days. An attacker running N fakes pays N×90-day lockups plus one escalating operator fine, so mass identity creation directly drains the controlling account.
